# NEW 2026-11-18 the 1341 civil war. Generated by gen_civil_war_1341.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# BYZ scope. Marks a once-only event and fires it.
oe_cw_fire = {
    set_variable = oe_cw_done_$n$
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cw.$n$
}

oe_cw_add_tide = {
    change_variable = { name = oe_cw_tide add = $amount$ }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_cw_tide min = 0 max = 100 }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly.
oe_cw_monthly = {
    # Act 1: relapses from June 1340 while Andronikos III reigns.
    if = {
        limit = {
            current_date >= 1340.6.1
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_cw_relapse_cd }
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_andronikos_illness_resolved }
            exists = character:byz_andronikos_iii_palaiologos
            character:byz_andronikos_iii_palaiologos = { is_alive = yes is_ruler_of = c:BYZ has_trait = oe_byz_andronikos_iii_I }
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_cw_relapse_cd months = 6 }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cw.1
    }
    # Act 2 fallback start (normally three days after the emperor's death).
    if = { limit = { oe_cw_can_begin = yes } oe_cw_begin = yes }
    # A betrothal becomes a marriage when John V turns 15.
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = oe_cw_betrothed
            exists = character:byz_john_v_palaiologos exists = character:byz_helena_kantakouzene
            character:byz_john_v_palaiologos = { is_alive = yes age_in_years >= 15 }
            character:byz_helena_kantakouzene = { is_alive = yes }
        }
        remove_variable = oe_cw_betrothed
        character:byz_john_v_palaiologos = { marry_character_ignore_blocks = character:byz_helena_kantakouzene }
    }
    # FX13 (2026-11-19): a pending war whose leader has died lapses; nothing else cleared oe_cw_pending / oe_cw_active.
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cw_pending NOT = { character:byz_john_kantakouzenos ?= { is_alive = yes } } } set_global_variable = oe_cw_lapsed oe_cw_close = yes }
    # A war that had to wait for another civil war to end.
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cw_pending oe_cw_war_possible = yes } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cw.6 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_cw_stage ?= 2 } oe_cw_war_monthly = yes }
}

# BYZ scope. Act 2 begins: the emperor is dead, John V is a minor, Kantakouzenos stands beside the throne.
oe_cw_begin = {
    set_global_variable = oe_cw_begun
    set_variable = oe_cw_active
    set_variable = { name = oe_cw_stage value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_cw_rift value = 30 }
    # The author's 'Kantakouzenos's ambition' (+300 influence) makes the rift wider from the start.
    if = {
        limit = {
            international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
                OR = {
                    AND = { has_variable = oe_nf_dynasty_1 var:oe_nf_dynasty_1 = dynasty:kantakouzenos_dynasty var:oe_nf_influence_1 > 300 }
                    AND = { has_variable = oe_nf_dynasty_2 var:oe_nf_dynasty_2 = dynasty:kantakouzenos_dynasty var:oe_nf_influence_2 > 300 }
                    AND = { has_variable = oe_nf_dynasty_3 var:oe_nf_dynasty_3 = dynasty:kantakouzenos_dynasty var:oe_nf_influence_3 > 300 }
                    AND = { has_variable = oe_nf_dynasty_4 var:oe_nf_dynasty_4 = dynasty:kantakouzenos_dynasty var:oe_nf_influence_4 > 300 }
                }
            }
        }
        change_variable = { name = oe_cw_rift add = 10 }
    }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cw.2
}

# BYZ scope. End of the fuse: war or joint rule. If another civil war is still being fought, the war waits for it.
oe_cw_decide = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_cw_rift var:oe_cw_rift >= 60 }
        if = { limit = { oe_cw_war_possible = yes } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cw.6 }
        else = { set_variable = oe_cw_pending }
    }
    else = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cw.7 }
}

# BYZ scope. Didymoteicho: Kantakouzenos raises Thrace.
oe_cw_war_start = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_cw_war_possible = no }
        set_variable = oe_cw_pending
    }
    else = {
        remove_variable = oe_cw_pending
        set_variable = { name = oe_cw_stage value = 2 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_cw_tide value = 40 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_cw_wm value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_cw_capm value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_cw_evcd months = 2 }
        # His base: Didymoteicho and the Thracian countryside. Adrianople and Komotini stay with the regency (their
        # townsmen expel the nobles the next day, event oe_cw.8).
        every_owned_location = {
            limit = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 2 is_capital = no NOT = { this = location:edirne } NOT = { this = location:komotini } }
            add_to_list = oe_cw_base
        }
        create_rebel = { category = estate estate = nobles_estate name = OE_CW_REBELS save_scope_as = oe_cw_rebel_group }
        every_in_list = {
            list = oe_cw_base
            every_pop = { limit = { owner = c:BYZ } change_pop_allegiance = scope:oe_cw_rebel_group }
        }
        scope:oe_cw_rebel_group = { start_civil_war = { save_scope_as = oe_cw_country } }
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:oe_cw_country }
            set_variable = { name = oe_cw_rebels value = scope:oe_cw_country }
            every_in_list = { list = oe_cw_base if = { limit = { owner = c:BYZ } change_location_owner = scope:oe_cw_country } }
            character:byz_john_kantakouzenos = { save_scope_as = oe_cw_k }
            scope:oe_cw_k = { move_country = scope:oe_cw_country }
            scope:oe_cw_country = { set_new_ruler = scope:oe_cw_k add_gold = 300 }
            location:demotica = {
                if = {
                    limit = { owner = scope:oe_cw_country }
                    create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_1_traditions_light_infantry owner = scope:oe_cw_country }
                    create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_1_traditions_light_infantry owner = scope:oe_cw_country }
                    create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_1_traditions_light_infantry owner = scope:oe_cw_country }
                    create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_1_traditions_light_cavalry owner = scope:oe_cw_country }
                    create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_1_traditions_light_cavalry owner = scope:oe_cw_country }
                }
            }
            # Disloyal themes that rise join this rebel state (oe_theme_revolt_start joins a theme rebel state at war).
            set_variable = { name = oe_theme_revolt_country value = scope:oe_cw_country }
            activate_situation = situation:oe_cw_war
            trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_cw.8 days = 1 }
            trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_cw.9 days = 3 }
        }
        else = { oe_cw_corule = yes }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Act 3 monthly.
oe_cw_war_monthly = {

    change_variable = { name = oe_cw_tide add = oe_cw_tide_delta }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_cw_tide min = 0 max = 100 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_cw_rebels ?= { has_ruler = yes } location:constantinople = { controller ?= c:BYZ.var:oe_cw_rebels } } change_variable = { name = oe_cw_capm add = 1 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_cw_capm value = 0 } }
    # Endings first.
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { var:oe_cw_tide >= 100 var:oe_cw_capm >= 3 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_cw_stage value = 3 }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cw.28
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { OR = { var:oe_cw_tide <= 0 in_civil_war = no } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_cw_stage value = 3 }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cw.29
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { OR = { var:oe_cw_wm >= 72 has_variable = oe_cw_peace_now } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_cw_stage value = 3 }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cw.30
    }
    else = {
        # Kantakouzenos flees to Serbia when his cause collapses.
        if = { limit = { var:oe_cw_tide < 30 country_exists = c:SER NOT = { has_variable = oe_cw_done_13 } } oe_cw_fire = { n = 13 } }

        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_cw_evcd } }

                chance = 25
                set_variable = { name = oe_cw_evcd months = 3 }

            10 = { trigger = { country_exists = c:AYD has_variable = oe_cw_wm var:oe_cw_wm >= 6 NOT = { has_variable = oe_cw_done_15 } } oe_cw_fire = { n = 15 } }

# BYZ scope. Serbia takes up to 2 places on the Macedonian border (6 at most over the whole war).
oe_cw_serbia_takes = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_cw_ser_ceded } } set_variable = { name = oe_cw_ser_ceded value = 0 } }
    oe_cw_serbia_take_one = yes
    oe_cw_serbia_take_one = yes
}
oe_cw_serbia_take_one = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            var:oe_cw_ser_ceded < 6
            country_exists = c:SER
            any_owned_location = { OR = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 7 var:oe_theme_region ?= 8 var:oe_theme_region ?= 9 } oe_cw_key_city = no is_capital = no any_neighbor_location = { owner ?= c:SER } }
        }
        random_owned_location = {
            limit = { OR = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 7 var:oe_theme_region ?= 8 var:oe_theme_region ?= 9 } oe_cw_key_city = no is_capital = no any_neighbor_location = { owner ?= c:SER } }
            change_location_owner = c:SER
        }
        change_variable = { name = oe_cw_ser_ceded add = 1 }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Joint rule without war (end of act 2).
oe_cw_corule = {
    if = { limit = { has_regent = yes exists = character:byz_john_kantakouzenos character:byz_john_kantakouzenos = { is_alive = yes owner = c:BYZ } } set_regent = character:byz_john_kantakouzenos }
    set_variable = oe_cw_betrothed
    add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cw_joint_rule years = 10 mode = replace }
    oe_cw_close = yes
}

# BYZ scope. Hands the rebels' cities back and annexes them while the emperor still reigns (same order as the theme
# usurpation fix of 2026-11-18: annexing while the rebels held the capital let the engine settle the war for them).
oe_cw_end_rebels = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cw_rebels } var:oe_cw_rebels = { save_scope_as = oe_cw_r } }
    character:byz_john_kantakouzenos ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes } save_scope_as = oe_cw_k move_country = c:BYZ } }
    if = {
        limit = { in_civil_war = yes exists = scope:oe_cw_r }
        every_owned_location = { limit = { controller ?= scope:oe_cw_r } change_location_controller = c:BYZ }
        annex_country = { country = scope:oe_cw_r reason = Diplomatic transfer = yes }
    }
}

oe_cw_finish_kantakouzenos = {
    oe_cw_end_rebels = yes
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_cw_k } set_variable = { name = oe_succession_settled days = 10 } set_new_ruler = scope:oe_cw_k scope:oe_cw_k = { oe_nf_member_influence = { amount = 200 } } }
    character:byz_john_v_palaiologos ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes owner = c:BYZ } save_scope_as = oe_cw_j5 } }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_cw_j5 } set_as_designated_heir = scope:oe_cw_j5 }
    set_variable = oe_cw_betrothed
    add_stability = stability_mild_bonus
    set_global_variable = oe_cw_kantakouzenos_won
    oe_cw_close = yes
}
oe_cw_finish_regency = {
    oe_cw_end_rebels = yes
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_cw_k } scope:oe_cw_k = { oe_nf_member_influence = { amount = -200 } kill_character_silently = this } }
    add_legitimacy = legitimacy_mild_bonus
    oe_cw_close = yes
}
oe_cw_finish_peace = {
    oe_cw_end_rebels = yes
    if = { limit = { has_regent = yes exists = scope:oe_cw_k } set_regent = scope:oe_cw_k }
    set_variable = oe_cw_betrothed
    add_stability = stability_weak_bonus
    oe_cw_close = yes
}

# BYZ scope. Common clean-up; the scars of the war last longer the longer it ran.
oe_cw_close = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_cw_stage var:oe_cw_stage >= 2 has_variable = oe_cw_wm }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_cw_wm < 24 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cw_scars years = 5 mode = replace } }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_cw_wm < 48 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cw_scars years = 10 mode = replace } }
        else = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cw_scars years = 15 mode = replace } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_cw_rebels has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_country var:oe_theme_revolt_country = var:oe_cw_rebels }
        remove_variable = oe_theme_revolt_country
        remove_variable = oe_theme_revolt_active
        remove_variable = oe_theme_usurp_months
    }
    if = { limit = { location:thessaloniki = { has_variable = oe_cw_commune } } trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_cw.31 days = 365 } }
    remove_variable = oe_cw_active
    remove_variable = oe_cw_stage
    remove_variable = oe_cw_rebels
    remove_variable = oe_cw_umur
    remove_variable = oe_cw_bul
    remove_variable = oe_cw_momchil
    remove_variable = oe_cw_pending
    set_global_variable = oe_cw_done
}
